data.name: DnsNameEmpty
data.value: A DNS name cannot be empty.

data.name: DnsNameTooLong
data.value: DNS name exceeds the RFC 1035 limit of 253 characters in presentation form: '{0}'.

data.name: DnsNameEmptyLabel
data.value: DNS name contains an empty label (consecutive dots): '{0}'.

data.name: DnsLabelTooLong
data.value: DNS label '{0}' exceeds the RFC 1035 limit of 63 octets.

data.name: TxtStringsEmpty
data.value: TXT record must carry at least one string.

data.name: TxtStringNull
data.value: TXT record strings cannot be null.

data.name: TxtStringTooLong
data.value: TXT record string exceeds the RFC 1035 limit of 255 octets (got {0}).

data.name: TxtRDataLengthMismatch
data.value: TXT RDATA: declared length {0} but consumed {1} octets

data.name: TxtRDataEmpty
data.value: TXT record must contain at least one string
